hero.eyebrow: Barna Karácsony · Integral counselor in training
hero.title: See more clearly when many things pull at once.
hero.subtitle: If you have already considered a situation from many angles but still cannot find room to move, we can look at it through thoughts, emotions, bodily signals, relationships, and values. The aim is to choose from a wider perspective.
hero.profile_alt: Barna Karácsony sitting in a yellow armchair
hero.note: I ask precise questions, look for connections, and leave room for what has not yet come together into a finished explanation.
hero.note_label: Clarity, depth, and room to move

cancellation.label: Cancellation and changes
cancellation.value: At least 24 hours before the session

existential.question: Is there room for existential or spiritual topics?
existential.answer: If they are a natural part of what you are experiencing, there can be room for them in our work. You do not need to accept any particular worldview.

spiritualScope.question: Do I need to relate to a particular perspective?
spiritualScope.answer: No. Integral counseling is not spiritual teaching, and it does not expect you to adopt any particular belief system.
